shell.lowUsage.title: Low-usage mode enabled
shell.lowUsage.subtitle: This device looks low-spec, so background usage was optimized automatically
shell.lowUsage.detail: When the window is minimized or covered, background decoration animations pause, the cursor glow turns off, and background refreshes such as memory and window scanning slow down; animations and visuals are unchanged while visible. You can turn this off in Settings if you don't need it.
